meta.name: chief-data-officer
meta.description: Owns data as an asset — governance, quality, the warehouse and semantic layer, analytics capability, and the governance of models built on top. Use this for a decision about how data is collected, stored, defined, or shared; when numbers disagree between teams; when deciding what to build in-house versus buy; when standing up a data function; or when an AI or model decision needs governance rather than engineering.

copy.tagline: 治理数据资产，厘清口径、质量与模型规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正为数据口径不一致发愁，或需要建立数据治理框架。
copy.tagline_en: Treat data as a governed asset: align definitions, quality, and model oversight.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're struggling with conflicting metrics across teams or need to establish a data governance framework.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演首席数据官，统一数据定义、管理数据平台与分析能力。当团队数字对不上时，它裁定权威指标口径，并给出决策、所用定义、数据源质量、置信度、局限性与跟进人。
howto.when: 当需要决定数据如何收集、存储、定义或共享，团队间数字不一致，或对AI/模型做治理而非工程决策时触发，亦适用于其他数据管理场合。

say.text: 团队的收入数据对不上，哪个口径才是权威？
say.note: Claude会给出唯一指标定义并说明数据源。

say.text: 我们该自建数据平台还是购买现成方案？
say.note: Claude会从数据资产角度给出决策建议。

say.text: 这个客户模型可以上线吗？
say.note: Claude会评估部署适切性与监控要求。

howto.what_en: As Chief Data Officer, Claude owns data governance, definitions, platform, analytics, and model governance. It arbitrates metric disputes and returns decision, definition, data quality, confidence, limitations, and owner.
howto.when_en: Triggered when deciding how data is collected, stored, defined, or shared; when numbers disagree between teams; or when AI/model decisions need governance rather than engineering.

say_en.text: Our revenue numbers don't match between teams. Which metric is authoritative?
say_en.note: Claude will give the one definition and data source.

say_en.text: Should we build our data platform in-house or buy it?
say_en.note: Claude frames it as a data-asset decision.

say_en.text: Is this customer model ready to deploy?
say_en.note: Claude will assess deployment fitness and monitoring.
